newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Abidjan bourse posts modest gain on week.
newsitem.headline: Abidjan bourse posts modest gain on week.

text.p: Ivory Coast equities posted a modest gain in the week to to Friday, the Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan (BVA) market report showed.

The BVA All-Share Index added 0.27 percent to 364.70 points from 363.72 points, taking the 1996 rise to 31.54 percent. The "12 VB" blue chips index rose 0.25 percent to 247.28 points from 246.7 points, a 1996 cumulative rise of 24.10 percent.
Turnover jumped to 433,314,000 CFA francs from 38,189,000 CFA the previous week, with shares traded sharply up at 15,383 from just 1,367.
